protocol.trigger: No Holm-significant bias tests and seed null comparison not significant at .05
protocol.model: Poisson mean regression with log-sales offset; standardized training features; ridge=1
protocol.baseline: same training rows, intercept and log-sales offset only
protocol.metrics: heldout mean Poisson deviance, MAE; positive baseline-minus-model deviance gain is better
protocol.uncertainty: 4999 circular block bootstraps, block length 10; descriptive fixed-model intervals
protocol.limitations: post-fallback exploratory analysis, not a profit estimate or a ticket-selection validation
